canonical_statement: Does every set of n distinct points in R^2 determine >> n/sqrt(log n) many distinct distances?
what_was_proved: an elementary Omega(sqrt n) lower bound (rung 1) plus a formal gap ledger; NOT the conjecture, NOT Guth-Katz

verification.mode: clean-room rebuild from the banked bytes

theorems.name: minimalDistinctDistances_eq_natSInf
theorems.role: statement firewall: the R-cast inside the imported set-builder is inert

theorems.name: fiber_card_le_two
theorems.role: two circles with distinct centres meet in at most two points

theorems.name: card_le_two_mul_distinctDistances_sq
theorems.statement: for every finite P subset R^2, #P <= 2 * (distinctDistances P)^2 + 2

theorems.name: sqrt_le_two_mul_minimalDistinctDistances
theorems.statement: for n >= 4, sqrt n <= 2 * minimalDistinctDistances n

theorems.name: sqrt_isBigO_minimalDistinctDistances
theorems.statement: (fun n => Real.sqrt n) =O[atTop] (fun n => (minimalDistinctDistances n : R))

theorems.name: sqrt_isBigO_target
theorems.statement: (fun n => Real.sqrt n) =O[atTop] (fun n => n / Real.sqrt (Real.log n))

theorems.name: sqrt_isLittleO_target
theorems.statement: (fun n => Real.sqrt n) =o[atTop] (fun n => n / Real.sqrt (Real.log n)) -- the gap is STRICT

theorems.name: target_implies_rung1
theorems.statement: for any g, (n/sqrt(log n)) =O[atTop] g -> (sqrt n) =O[atTop] g

semantic_binding.elaborated_form: fun n => sInf {x : Nat | exists points, exists (_ : #points = n), (distinctDistances points : R) = (x : R)}
semantic_binding.note: the imported definition returns Nat; the R-cast in the set-builder is discharged by Nat.cast injectivity and proved inert in-file

explicitly_not_proved: erdos_89 : (fun n => n / sqrt(log n)) =O[atTop] minimalDistinctDistances  -- the OPEN conjecture
erdos_89.variants.grid_upper_bound : the Erdos/Moser grid upper bound (needs Landau-Ramanujan)
